expectations.text: The normal sequence is authorize, import, review mappings, Start sync after all mapped; import alone does not start sync.
expectations.evidence: Numbered sequence authorizes desired shop, imports, reviews mappings, then Start sync after all mapped; explicitly states import does not start order sync.

expectations.text: It gives Mapping status location, Mapped/Unmatched conditions, and Link item or inventory-lead remedy only for Unmatched rows.
expectations.evidence: Connections > Products > Mapping status is specified. Mapped rows are ready and must not be remapped; only Unmatched rows receive Link item or inventory-lead creation instructions.

expectations.text: Disconnect/reimport and Reauthorize are clearly conditional on wrong shop and Authorization expired respectively, not universal prerequisites.
expectations.evidence: Separate conditional recovery bullets restrict Disconnect/reauthorize/reimport to wrong shop shown under Connections > Account, and Reauthorize to Authorization expired status.
